subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan - FinServCorp
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodai.com>
To: Amit Shah <amit@finservcorp.com>, Sophie Lang <sophie.lang@finservcorp.com>
Cc: Lukas Meyer <lukas@redwoodai.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwoodai.com>
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan

Hi Amit / Sophie —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Really appreciated the thoughtful questions from the ML and platform teams. Quick recap and a proposed POC/eval plan so we can get the kickoff scheduled: 

1) Demo recap (short):
- Walked through Redwood Hosted API, Dedicated routing options, and a sample inference pipeline with caching/batching.
- Showed latency/cost dashboard, and an example rollout policy for fallback to a smaller quantized variant.

2) Proposed POC objective:
- Validate that Redwood can meet FinServCorp's latency SLO (p95 < 250ms for 512-token responses) under realistic traffic, and that per-token cost is within your target (<= $0.002/token for typical workloads).

3) Success criteria (what we’ll measure):
- Latency: p95 and p99 under your test traffic patterns (target p95 < 250ms).
- Cost: measured unit cost on test corpus and projected monthly spend.
- Functional: generation quality on your prompts (acceptance on a 20-prompt test set, target >= 85% pass rate).
- Operational: seamless auth (SSO), audit log visibility, and SOC2 evidence review.

4) Evaluation plan & timeline (proposed):
- Week 0 (2026-08-10): Kickoff and environment setup (API keys, SSO test account, data residency confirmation).
- Week 1: Ingest test prompts, run baseline using hosted API, collect latency/cost metrics.
- Week 2: Optimized runs (batching, quantized variant), run concurrent traffic tests.
- Week 3: Acceptance testing on 20-prompt set and final readout.

5) Owners / roles:
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (POC lead), Lukas Meyer (SE / tech onboarding), Dev Patel (infra & routing config).
- FinServCorp: Amit Shah (product owner), Sophie Lang (platform/security).

6) Ask / next steps:
- Can you confirm the kickoff week of 2026-08-10 (Wed) works for the FinServCorp team?
- Please confirm any legal/security prerequisites (e.g., SOC2, SSO provider, data residency).

I attached a one-page POC outline and a proposed timeline spreadsheet. Also linking the shared doc so we can iterate: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cPOCOutline

If that looks good, I’ll send a calendar invite for the kickoff and loop in engineering for specific test data/traffic patterns.

Best,

Marissa Cole

Hi Amit / Sophie —

Great — glad Aug 11 afternoon ET works. I’ve attached Redwood’s latest SOC2 report (redacted) and a short SSO integration note. Confirming: we can pin the POC environment to us-east (we’ll reserve dedicated capacity in that region for the trial).

On token budget: for the Week 2 concurrent load test we recommend budgeting ~5M tokens (this gives us enough headroom for 100 concurrent sessions at your expected 50-100 tokens per request over a 1-hour soak). We’ll share a more detailed token-cost projection in the onboarding doc.

I’ve also attached a POC timeline spreadsheet (20260803-POC-timeline.xlsx). Lukas will lead the technical onboarding — Lukas, can you share the test prompt format you’d like and the best way for them to share synthetic test traffic?

Next: I’ll send the calendar invite for Aug 11 2:30pm ET with a short agenda (kickoff, SSO, test data handoff).

Thanks,
Marissa
